title: Two high Spades or five strong Hearts?
author_notes: Reviewed during EC-033 implementation; see docs/COACHING_REVIEW.md. Independent hand; ratings are authored judgments, not probabilities or guaranteed outcomes.

feedback.title: Start with the controlled suit
feedback.summary: Four Hearts builds on three top trumps and the Diamond Ace without relying on both Spade honors.
points: Control: Ace-King-Queen of Hearts head a five-card trump holding.
Probable: Diamond Ace and promoted Hearts can support the plan.
Risk: King-Queen of Spades still face the Ace; neither is automatically a side winner.

feedback.title: Heart length adds flexibility
feedback.summary: Five Hearts is a supported plan using top trump control, length, and a side Ace. It still depends on play.
points: Control: Ace-King-Queen of Hearts head a five-card trump holding.
Probable: Diamond Ace and promoted Hearts can support the plan.
Risk: King-Queen of Spades still face the Ace; neither is automatically a side winner.

feedback.title: Six needs conditional extras
feedback.summary: Six Hearts relies on promoted low trumps, useful ruffs, or Spade honors surviving.
points: Control: Ace-King-Queen of Hearts head a five-card trump holding.
Probable: Diamond Ace and promoted Hearts can support the plan.
Risk: King-Queen of Spades still face the Ace; neither is automatically a side winner.

feedback.title: Two honors do not give length
feedback.summary: Four Spades has side strength, but K-Q alone must face the Ace and leaves little trump control afterward.
points: Control: King-Queen are your only Spades, and the Ace is missing.
Risk: the strong Hearts become side cards opponents may ruff.
Comparison: trump choice needs length and control, not just two attractive honors.

feedback.title: High ranks cannot replace trump length
feedback.summary: Five Spades depends on short, non-top trump and Hearts surviving as side winners.
points: Control: King-Queen are your only Spades, and the Ace is missing.
Risk: the strong Hearts become side cards opponents may ruff.
Comparison: trump choice needs length and control, not just two attractive honors.

feedback.title: Too much pressure on two trumps
feedback.summary: Six Spades stretches the target while exposing a strong Heart suit to opposing ruffs.
points: Control: King-Queen are your only Spades, and the Ace is missing.
Risk: the strong Hearts become side cards opponents may ruff.
Comparison: trump choice needs length and control, not just two attractive honors.
